subject.title: feat(ui): Codex-style minimal sidebar — pinned/chats groups, icon footer, no brand header

question: Should this PR land with Overview as the only default pinned destination and with the Recent collapse preference removed?
rationale: Those choices change browser-local navigation defaults and retire an existing preference, so green tests and screenshots do not by themselves settle product compatibility.

options.title: Accept the session-first default
options.body: Land the PR as written and intentionally move Workboard and Agents under More for users without stored custom pins while retiring the Recent collapse control.

options.title: Preserve existing navigation defaults
options.body: Keep Workboard and Agents pinned by default, or retain/migrate the Recent collapse preference, before merging the rest of the layout cleanup.

options.title: Pause the sidebar direction
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers do not want another sidebar default change immediately after the predecessor PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the session-first default
recommendation.body: Land the PR as written and intentionally move Workboard and Agents under More for users without stored custom pins while retiring the Recent collapse control.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current sidebar follow-up and the merged predecessor sidebar design that this PR refines.
